author: Inside Edition
description: A giant hot air balloon touched down in a small backyard. The homeowners greeted their 13 unexpected guests before marveling over the 80-foot high balloon towering over their home in Temecula, California. Homeowner Hunter Perrin tells Inside Edition it was a neighbor who first alerted him of what happened and then he ran out with his wife Jenna. Passenger Brianna Avalosa was on the balloon ride as a special treat celebrating her 10-year wedding anniversary.
title: Giant Hot Air Balloon With 13 People Lands In California Backyard

author: Inside Edition
description: Students elected their principal as prom king, an expression of gratitude for saving their lives from an accused campus shooter at Pauls Valley High School in Oklahoma armed with two semi-automatic pistols. Principal Kurt Moore rushed out of his office and tackled the suspected gunman, averting what police say could have been a massacre. During the scuffle, Moore suffered a shot in the leg. Still recovering from his wound, he showed up to prom. DJ Birk Ozbirn was in on the surprise.
title: Students Elect Their Hero Principal As Prom King In Surprise

author: Inside Edition
description: Eight children were killed in Louisiana over the weekend and officials say the gunman was father to seven of them. Shreveport Police say Shemar Elkins shot his seven children and one of their cousins inside his home on Sunday. Investigators say the shootings were carried out execution style, but some of the children tried to make a run for it. Cops say Elkins also shot two women. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 8 Children Dead After Father Goes On Shooting Spree In Louisiana
